answer.headline: New England commercial airports ranked by NPIAS need per enplanement

claims.text: Estimated NPIAS 2025-2029 development need per CY2025 enplanement, highest to lowest, is PQI {F13}, HYA {F9}, ACK {F1}, WST {F17}, ORH {F12}, PSM {F14}, BID {F5}, HVN {F8}, MVY {F11}, BTV {F7}, MHT {F10}, BGR {F4}, PWM {F16}, BDL {F2}, PVD {F15}, and BOS {F6}. None of these estimates are equal, so there is no tie.

The calculated set-relative scores for that same order are PQI {F18}, HYA {F19}, ACK {F20}, WST {F21}, ORH {F22}, PSM {F23}, BID {F24}, HVN {F25}, MVY {F26}, BTV {F27}, MHT {F28}, BGR {F29}, PWM {F30}, BDL {F31}, PVD {F32}, and BOS {F33}.
BED has an estimated NPIAS development need of {F34}, but CY2025 enplanements are {F35}, so need per enplanement is {F36} and BED is left out of the rank.

The scores only restate the estimated-ratio order inside this set: PQI is at the top of the scale {F18} and BOS is at the bottom {F33}. A high value is not evidence of unmet demand, unused terminal capacity, or higher profitability.

assumptions: New England is the Census New England division (Connecticut, Maine, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Rhode Island, and Vermont). The name resolved to that division exactly.
Commercial airports are those at or above the catalog commercial enplanement floor. Airports below that floor are excluded.

The denominator is CY2025 FAA ACAIS enplanements. The numerator is the current NPIAS 2025-2029 development-need estimate, a static release, so the time window does not apply to the need figure itself.
Airports are ordered with higher estimated need per enplanement first. The rank uses that one metric. It is not the multi-factor investment screen.
limitations: NPIAS amounts are sponsor-reported five-year AIP-eligible need estimates, not funding awarded and not a valuation.
Need per enplanement does not measure unmet demand, terminal capacity, fares, or profitability. Those are not in this data.
The ratio pairs a multi-year need estimate with one calendar year of enplanements, so it is not an annualized capital cost and it would change if another enplanement year were used.
Rank scores are relative to the airports in this set and change if airports are added or removed.

BED cannot be ordered on this metric for CY2025 because enplanements for that year are missing, even though a need estimate exists and the airport cleared the commercial floor on its latest enplanement year.
